intent: Add a date field PromisedDate to the order, then add a rule that the delivery date must be on or before the promised date.

messages.text: Delivery must not be after the promised date.

notes: Batch-repair: exercises `apply`'s atomic rollback + per-op attribution. The obvious composition trips one op (the rule's date comparison invites the ISO-literal or date-diff-sign slip → that op is `rejected`), so the whole batch ROLLS BACK with a per-op envelope naming which op failed and why. Scored on whether the agent reads the rolled-back, per-op-attributed envelope, fixes the offending op, and re-applies to green — recovery at the batch level, the complement to N-correct's single-call recovery. Activates with `apply` (Phase 3).
